# hatsu_ino

> Arduino-based JDM car melody box that plays an audio file through a speaker when the car's ignition turns on, then sleeps until the next start.

hatsu_ino ("hatsu" = first sound, "ino" = Arduino) is an open-source (MIT licensed) hardware + firmware project. Each board revision is self-contained under `boards/<version>/` in the source repo, with its own wiring guide and Arduino sketch.

- **v0**: A JDM car melody box that plays a WAV audio file when you start your car.
- **v1**: A JDM car melody box that plays an MP3 file when you start your car — built around a DFPlayer Mini module instead of driving audio from the Nano itself.

## Docs

- [Home](https://arturvrsampaio.github.io/hatsu_ino/): project overview and board list
- [v0 board guide](https://arturvrsampaio.github.io/hatsu_ino/boards/v0/): components, wiring, and setup for v0
- [v1 board guide](https://arturvrsampaio.github.io/hatsu_ino/boards/v1/): components, wiring, and setup for v1
